crossRefs.note: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when…
He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”
He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his…
In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
both low and high, rich and poor together.
He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

translations.web: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
translations.bsb: Then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
translations.kjv: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
translations.asv: And the kings of the earth, and the princes, and the chief captains, and the rich, and the strong, and every bondman and freeman, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains;
